label: 블러드 녹턴 3D
note: 3D app update. Chapter 1 can be played from its first line to an ending card: at half health the banshee queen tears through the bell of her hall into the night of 1697, the hero follows by ringing that bell, drives her back and sends her with the knell; her health is carried across the two nights; a fall at the queen stands him up at the bread before her door; after the last scene an ending card shows the bell's ring reaching two new places and the game returns to the 3D chooser. Enemies wait while the story holds the hero (a dialogue, a camera cut, a crossing). Buttons are no longer swallowed: a press of attack, roll, jump or skill made up to 0.19 s before the hero is free is carried and fires on the first free tick, and the roll is untouchable for nearly all of its length. Hits have four weights (light, medium, heavy, finishing) in stop, shake, sound and vibration, drawn on the very frame the lash lands, and several things struck at once sound like several. That night's graveyard road gives a breath before its three corpses, and the slot beside the fallen stair that looked open is open. Saves written by the previous build load and continue. Known, fixed in the next build: in the chapter's last scene one of the two girls stands half hidden behind a statue, and the pad stays on screen during camera cuts. The 2D app is unchanged (462996).
